statements: for _ in LITERAL..LITERAL with at most 32 iterations
expressions: +, -, * only inside executable if conditions; Verus must discharge fixed-width overflow/underflow
accepted.loops: literal ranges are exhaustively unrolled; this is not a general loop invariant or recursion theorem
accepted.assumptions: preserved at their source program point; each translated assertion path gets a separate existential Verus non-vacuity obligation over the original fixed-width parameter domains
accepted.machine_arithmetic: Kani uses checked Rust overflow semantics at the pinned revision; translated +,-,* remain in executable Verus if conditions, where Verus requires overflow/underflow absence. Ghost arithmetic is rejected because Verus widens it.
accepted.generics: source functions with unbounded type parameters only when Kani autoharness selected an explicit monomorphic instance and every selected type is in the supported fixed-width integer/Boolean set; the result is scoped to that concrete instantiation

rejected: arithmetic in assert!/kani::assume, division/remainder, casts, and arithmetic outside executable if conditions
references, raw pointers, slices, allocation and user ADTs
generic trait-bound syntax, const generics, lifetimes, target-width generic arguments, dynamic loops, named loop variables and recursion
semantic_bridge.translation_trust: Structural lowering is an explicit trusted correspondence boundary and is regression-tested. Scoped assumptions are additionally guarded by Verus-checked assertion-path non-vacuity obligations. No general Rust-to-Verus translation soundness is claimed.
